notes.content:
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where the Thorn Collider did not work properly.

notes.title: Bug Fixes: v0.8.1.2.1
notes.content:
[b][u]Bug Fixes: v0.8.1.2.1[/u][/b]

[b]Hello, players![/b]  
This update focuses on fixing critical bugs to improve your gameplay experience. Details below:

[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where single-use impact switches became unresponsive after re-entering a room.
[*] Resolved a bug causing incorrect descriptions to appear when holding directional keys to scroll through inventory items or research notes.
[*] Addressed a problem in the Rainbow Station map where save points could be activated from a distance.
[*] Fixed an overlap issue where switching between save points and research notes wouldn’t function correctly.
[*] Corrected animation sync issues when players or Handos watched story scenes in accelerated playback.
[*] Fixed a bug where UI elements in G's Shop were not properly displayed according to screen resolution.
[/list]

[b]Your feedback keeps improving the game! Thank you for your support.[/b] 😊

notes.title: Pad controller freezing issue in demo build
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44577652/ba12e60fdcb0df2d96200e36a4b357fee560ae1b.png[/img]
Hi.
This is Team Flask! 

In the current demo, we have checked there is a bug that prevents further in-game interactions from progressing when using a pad controller.
This issue does not occur when using the keyboard, and the problem occurs only when using the pad controller.

Until bugs are resolved, we recommend playing the demo using keyboards.

Thank you!

notes.title: DEMO REALEASE!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44577652/f27f2f4690562ae4e115db5844f28104aa2cfcd4.png[/img]

Hi
This is Team Flask 

Halchemist's demo has finally been uploaded!
The demo can be played from the tutorial part to the first area, Rainbow Station.

We support Korean, Japanese, and English, and we plan to add additional languages.

Please look forward to Mercuri and Hando’s tag action Metroidvania Halchemist! 

thank you
